question: Which government department has partnered with Apna to provide skilled manpower to startups?

options.text: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **DPIIT and Apna** have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to help DPIIT-registered startups hire skilled manpower.
 
• Startups on the **Bhaskar platform** (over 7,00,000 entities) each receive **₹2,000 in hiring credits** on Apna, totaling an initial value of **₹140 crore**.
 
• As the startup ecosystem grows, the initiative’s worth could scale up to **₹300 crore**.
 
• These credits enable startups to post jobs and leverage **AI-driven talent matching** tools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Partnership Objective**: To provide a robust talent pipeline for India’s booming startup sector.
 
• **Bhaskar Platform**: A DPIIT initiative where 7,00,000 startups are registered, all eligible for hiring credits.
 
• **AI-driven Tools**: Helps startups reach relevant job seekers quickly and efficiently.
 
• **Scalability**: The initial ₹140 crore worth of credits can grow up to ₹300 crore as more startups join.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **DPIIT (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade)**__

 __
 
• Operates under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• Responsible for formulating and implementing industrial policy, promoting foreign direct investment (FDI), and supporting startups.
 
 
 
• **Apna**__
 
 
• A professional networking and job placement platform designed for India’s workforce.
 
• Utilizes AI technology to match job seekers with employers efficiently.
